title: Static external lock workspace_input pin desynchronized from Cargo.lock at the final state

evidence.detail: python -m unittest discover -s crates/opi-eval/scripts -p 'test_*.py' at audit_head: Ran 294, FAILED (failures=1): assertEqual e2adf702 != 261a3ec5

evidence.detail: git show 7a0fe85:Cargo.lock | sha256sum = e2adf702...; the static lock was last touched at e40c46f and still records the 3908fba-era 261a3ec5; at 3908fba both sides were 261a3ec5 (consistent)

title: native_tb3_artifact_witness fails at audit_head: nop expectation contradicts the declared-artifact binding
claim: The committed TB3 native witness test (task 19.3's declared verification command for P19-AC-004) cannot pass at audit_head: its nop-witness case expects a bound reward-zero result with the declared artifact collected, but the pinned foodstuff-beta-activity task declares only /app/results.txt (agent-created), the upstream nop agent never creates it, and the production binding correctly rejects native-binding-declared-artifact-missing (Integrity), so the conformance CLI exits 1 and the test's assertion of exit 0 fails.

evidence.location: crates/opi-eval/tests/native_driver.rs:3858-3907 (native_tb3_artifact_witness; asserts task_id=='foodstuff-beta-activity', artifacts==['/app/results.txt'], collected.len()==1 and exit 0 for both cases)
evidence.detail: executed with materials-r9/tb30 (current lock): oracle-witness passed; nop-witness FAILED — real upstream grader ran (verifier stdout 'Mean: 0.000, Reward 0.0') but binding rejected declared-artifact-missing; retained evidence /tmp/opi-eval-terminal-bench-3.0-nop-witness-G6TW8Z

the rejection is the documented 19.3 contract ('reject undeclared/substituted/missing artifacts') and matches the operator's live z-batch semantics (tb30-z2 'pi finished clean but emitted no declared artifact -> invalid'), so the test expectation, not the binding, is wrong

artifacts = ['/app/results.txt']; verifier environment_mode='separate'; nothing in the task or conformance staging creates the file for a nop agent (conformance.rs only selects the upstream oracle/nop agents, no artifact staging)

criterion_source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-phase19-local-native-agent-evaluation-design.md#7 P19-AC-004 ('Native witness changes only a declared artifact ... both real Agents traverse that handoff')
reproduction: OPI_EVAL_NATIVE_WITNESS_MATERIAL=<tb30 material with foodstuff task> cargo test -p opi-eval --test native_driver native_tb3_artifact_witness -- --ignored --exact (fails on nop-witness with native-binding-declared-artifact-missing)

title: native_provider_failure_report fails at audit_head: accepted-reason enumeration omits the deliberate retry-exhaustion spelling

evidence.location: crates/opi-eval/tests/native_driver.rs:8066-8076 (accepted reasons: provider-auth-failure | provider-rate-limit-exhausted | provider-protocol-error | provider-failure | pi:import-unsupported-schema)

title: Stage-deadline witness fails: 64 MiB native capture ceiling turns graded benchmark-valid timeouts into invalid trials
claim: remediation_native_stage_deadlines fails at audit_head (reproduced deterministically twice in this environment): in its time-cap case both trials settle invalid with reason native-capture-refused (Evidence boundary) after the captured stream exceeds the fixed 64 MiB STREAM_LIMIT_BYTES ceiling, while the test expects two valid graded timeout outcomes; the same ceiling already blocked the operator's real DeepSWE Opi trials (67,109,241 B and 67,109,049 B vs 67,108,864 B, two attempts refused), so high-volume trials cannot demonstrate benchmark-valid timeout grading through the capture path.

evidence.location: crates/opi-eval/src/native_capture.rs:47 (STREAM_LIMIT_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024; module doc: streams exceeding the ceiling refuse)
evidence.detail: observed twice: terminal-bench-2.1/time-cap exits 1 with coverage_counts valid=0 invalid=2, both trials' outcome reason 'native-capture-refused' (boundary evidence), run report run_outcome=incomplete; positive cases pass (valid=2)

evidence.location: crates/opi-eval/tests/native_driver.rs:11517 (expects valid==2 for the non-verifier-timeout time-cap case)
evidence.detail: /home/luiz/phase19-acceptance-r2/logs and operator-record.json: 'opi capture refused: source 67,109,241 B > 67,108,864 by 377 B' (deepswe-z1) and '... by 185 B' (deepswe-z2) — the ceiling converted two real agent attempts into invalid (superseded) trials, corroborating the mechanism on real evidence

AgentTimeoutError with a bound reward stays GradedNative only when capture admission succeeds; a refused capture seals NoOutcome/invalid instead — the spec's 'benchmark-valid timeout retains its native metric' is unreachable for streams over the ceiling

criterion_source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-phase19-local-native-agent-evaluation-design.md#6 (valid task timeouts remain valid graded outcomes; capture/seal rejection stays explicit) and #7 P19-AC-008
reproduction: OPI_EVAL_NATIVE_WITNESS_MATERIAL=<tb21+tb30 material> cargo test -p opi-eval --test native_driver remediation_native_stage_deadlines -- --ignored --exact (fails at time-cap; two deterministic reproductions, 179.4s each)
